summary: iter148 frontend testing (Sprint 2 P0 + Sprint 3). Tested all 5 review areas as creator (seeded via device_keys.role='creator' + session_token from /api/auth/login for test_dash_1777658375@gmail.com/Pass1234). Site was in 'private' mode; had to promote our ECDSA device key to creator in MongoDB to bypass SiteLockedOverlay. Once creator, dashboard renders all target testids. Findings — CRITICAL: tutorial-next / tutorial-prev / tutorial-finish and header-tutorial-btn clicks do NOT advance / navigate reliably, most likely because the global CalyChatbot floating widget (bottom-right, mounted in App.js line 246) overlaps and intercepts pointer events on the tutorial footer buttons AND (via z-index / event propagation) also blocks the header-tutorial-btn click from firing navigate('/tutorial'). Direct navigation to /tutorial URL works, initial step 'identity' renders, and the jump rail (tutorial-jump-identity, tutorial-jump-moderation, tutorial-jump-languages) works perfectly (verified switching to step 3 = moderation and step 7 = languages). LanguageToggle inside tutorial-step-languages renders correctly. All 3 tabs (journal-tab-bot/staff/anon) + 3 bot filters (bot-filter-all/with_llm/high_score) are wired and clickable inside AnonymityJournalPanel. mentions-bell-btn IS visible bottom-right, mentions-panel-overlay opens on click and mentions-panel-close successfully closes the panel. All 6 Sprint-3 route buttons (creator-caly-prog-btn, creator-bots-prog-btn, creator-private-site-btn, creator-private-ai-btn, creator-agent-registry-btn, creator-integrations-btn) render on Dashboard (visible in screenshot). Language toggle in header opens dropdown listing 18 languages (fr, en, es, pt, de, nl, ru, zh, zh-TW, hi, bn, ur, ja, hr, da, ar, plus more); switching from en->fr persists to localStorage.codeforge_language=fr (verified). The dashboard h1 stays 'CodeForge AI' because the app name is not localized (that's expected, brand name).

ui_bugs.issue: tutorial-next button clicks do NOT advance the step (progress stays at 14% after 6 clicks). Similarly header-tutorial-btn on Dashboard does not navigate to /tutorial when clicked. Root cause hypothesis: CalyChatbot floating widget mounted globally in App.js (position fixed bottom-right) overlaps the tutorial footer buttons and possibly the header icon zone. Playwright force=true click did not bypass this — indicates the React onClick handler is not firing at all, not just visual occlusion. Users using a normal browser will be unable to progress through the tutorial with Next button (they CAN use the jump-rail buttons, which do work).

When device is 'pending' and site_mode = private, the login page inputs remain readonly (readonly attribute is only removed onFocus). A programmatic fill fails; real users can log in because they click first. Not strictly a bug but makes automated testing very hard — consider removing readonly-then-focus trick or exposing a data-testid-based alternative for QA.

integration_issues.issue: None of the footer navigation buttons in /tutorial appear to trigger their onClick — confirmed by progress-bar style staying at 14% (step 0) after 6 tutorial-next clicks, and tutorial-prev also not decrementing. Very likely a click-interception by CalyChatbot floating widget or an underlying stopPropagation on a wrapper.

issues: CalyChatbot floating widget (bottom-right, pink) overlaps the tutorial-finish button on the last step (visible in screenshot). Even if the click intercept is fixed, the visual overlap harms UX — consider hiding CalyChatbot on /tutorial route or repositioning.

action_items: HIGH: Investigate why tutorial-next / tutorial-prev / tutorial-finish / header-tutorial-btn onClick handlers do not fire. Likely fix: hide <CalyChatbot /> on the /tutorial route (or when location.pathname === '/tutorial'), or lower its z-index below tutorial footer buttons, and check the Dashboard header for any invisible sibling covering header-tutorial-btn.
MEDIUM: On /tutorial page, ensure CalyChatbot is hidden or moved so it doesn't visually overlap the 'Terminer' button on the last step.
LOW: Consider adding a QA-friendly way to bypass the readonly onFocus trick on Login inputs (currently blocks Playwright fill unless localStorage session_token is injected).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js line 246 mounts <CalyChatbot /> globally — this floats bottom-right on EVERY route including /tutorial, causing visual + interaction conflict with tutorial footer buttons.
Tutorial.js has correct state machine (setStep with useMemo, disabled prev at 0, finish button at last step) — the code itself looks correct; the issue is external interception.

Login.js inputs use readonly + onFocus removeAttribute anti-autofill pattern — makes automated testing brittle. Consider using autoComplete='off' + data-lpignore='true' (already present) without readonly.
AnonymityJournalPanel.jsx correctly implements 3 tabs + 3 bot filters with data-testid conventions; useMemo for refusalHotspots and filteredBot is well-scoped.

MentionNotifier.jsx correctly gates rendering with `enabled` (role !== inactive/blocked), polls unread-count every 20s, and shows the panel with proper close button. Anonymous-safe fallback via `hidden` flag is honored.
Dashboard.js is very large (>1600 lines) — 700+ lines above the JSX. Consider splitting into smaller components (header, sidebar, main-grid) for maintainability.

Then navigate to /dashboard — all creator UI renders. AnonymityJournalPanel + MentionNotifier + LanguageToggle + all 6 Sprint-3 route buttons verified visible/functional. The KEY BUG to retest is: tutorial navigation buttons (next/prev/finish/header) don't fire onClick — hypothesis is CalyChatbot floating widget interception. E1 should try hiding CalyChatbot on /tutorial route and re-verify. Also note: header-tutorial-btn is a small graduation-cap icon in the LEFT part of the header; it renders but clicks are absorbed.
rca of the issue: tutorial-next / tutorial-prev / tutorial-finish / header-tutorial-btn all fail to fire their React onClick handlers even with Playwright force=true (which normally bypasses visual overlays via CDP). This suggests either: (a) an invisible full-viewport wrapper is capturing pointer events (unlikely since jump-buttons work), (b) CalyChatbot's floating widget attaches document-level event listeners with capture:true and stopPropagation, or (c) the buttons themselves have some conditional disabled state we missed. Recommended fix path: 1) Hide CalyChatbot when location.pathname === '/tutorial' (App.js), 2) If dashboard header-tutorial-btn still fails, inspect z-index / stacking context around <header> and specifically check ExportApprovalNotifier modal (which we saw block clicks in one run — it may re-open silently).
